source_name: Slo-Tech forum – payments threads (VALÚ vs mBills etc.)
why_relevant: Largest Slovenian tech community; threads reveal real merchant acceptance friction, fee complaints and product changes for wallets before/without official communication — an indirect signal source, not evidence.

Third-party corpus that has captured Slovenian 'razpisna dokumentacija' (tender documents) which are often removed from the originating portal after the deadline. Useful for retrieving historic tender specifications when the primary source has rotated them out.

source_name: Marand d.o.o. — corporate site (actor-map entry, banking relevance unconfirmed)
why_relevant: Named in the cell brief as a domestic IT house. Two searches (sl and en) returned no evidence of Slovenian banking references for Marand — the visible public footprint is engineering/health informatics (openEHR) rather than banking. Listed at low priority as an actor to check directly rather than as an evidenced banking source; the URL is the conventional corporate domain and is provided unverified.

source_name: MiCAwatch - Slovenia country page (third-party MiCA licence tracker)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator that tracks MiCA authorisations per country and names SI-authorised CASPs (e.g. ILIRIKA borzno posredniska hisa d.d., INCREMENTUM d.o.o., Orcabay d.o.o.). Useful as a fast cross-check and change alert, but it is a secondary source and must be validated against ATVP/ESMA before use.

A large state-owned enterprise that both buys and distributes POS acceptance, and is itself a contracting authority under SI procurement rules. Its terminal and payment-partner disclosures identify who supplies the state-owned distribution channel.

Second Slovenian blockchain/digital-asset body; useful to cross-check membership against Blockchain Alliance Europe and to identify crypto-payments actors that interact with banks (account access, MiCA licensing). Content and membership depth not yet verified.
